0.1 This Indian Standard was adopted by the Indian Standards Institution on 10 November 1982, after the draft finalized by the Pest Control Sectional Committee taad been approved by the Asricultural and Food Products Division Council and the Chemical Division Council. 0.2 EthioD emulsifiable concentrates are used as nonsystemio insecticido and acaricide. 0.3 BthioD emulsifiable concentrates are lenerally manufactured to contain SO percent ( mlm) of _biOOt technical. ~ 0.4 In the prepm:atio~of this standard due consideration has been liven to the provisions of the lns.cticldel Act. 1968 and the Rules f$med thereunder. value should be the same as that of tbe .pecified value in tbis standard.
